title: Executivo de vendas
description:
Venha fazer parte da Lindt Brasil!


Estamos com uma excelente oportunidade em nossa equipe


O que buscamos!


Nosso Executivo de vendas (Belo Horizonte - MG) tem como principal missão gerar crescimento sustentável de receita, garantindo presença, giro e rentabilidade dos produtos no mercado. Trabalho focando em campo e execução, 100% do tempo acompanhando e suportando as equipes da segunda força de vendas e top 20 clientes de cada uma das 4 operações de distribuição no estado de MG. Viagem é uma necessidade semanal.


Responsabilidades:


  • Gestão de contas e clientes : relacionamento com distribuidores e grandes varejistas, negociação de contratos, volumes, preços e condições comerciais.
  • Execução da estratégia comercial : implementação do plano de vendas, campanhas promocionais, lançamentos e ações de positivação nos pontos de venda.
  • Análise de mercado e resultados : acompanhamento de indicadores (sell-in, sell-out, cobertura, mix, margem, rupturas, scanntech, mtrix), análise de dados e identificação de oportunidades de crescimento.
  • Planejamento e previsão de vendas : elaboração de JBPs com parceiros, definição de metas e alinhamento com áreas como marketing, logística e supply chain.
  • Gestão de equipes e parceiros (Distribuidores) : direcionamento, acompanhamento e desenvolvimento de representantes, vendedores e promotores de venda. 90% do tempo em rota.
  • Execução no ponto de venda : garantia de visibilidade, exposição adequada, cumprimento de planogramas e ações de trade marketing.
  • Negociação e tomada de decisão : condução de negociações estratégicas com foco em rentabilidade e construção de parcerias de longo prazo.
  • Gestão de recursos financeiros : gestão e controle de contratos, ações de rebaixa/visibilidade, orçamento e conta corrente.
  • Viagem é uma necessidade semanal.


Requisitos:


  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • CNH ativa;
  • Perfil Analítico e Hands on;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.


O que oferecemos!


Em nossa empresa, valorizamos cada colaborador como um pilar essencial do nosso sucesso. Por isso, oferecemos benefícios únicos que cuidam de você e de sua família!


  • Oferecemos benefícios de alimentação que valorizam sua autonomia. Com nosso VR e VA, você decide como e onde se alimentar, com qualidade e liberdade.
  • Convênio Médico: Nosso plano de saúde e odontológico garante o cuidado que você e sua família merecem.
  • Convênio com Academias: Bem-estar que faz parte do seu dia a dia! Temos parceria com academias para que você possa manter a energia e a saúde em alta. (Total Pass)
  • Seguro de Vida: Porque cuidar de você e da sua família é prioridade. Nosso seguro de vida garante proteção e segurança em qualquer momento da jornada.
  • Desconto nos Produtos Lindt: Desfrute dos nossos chocolates inigualáveis com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores.
  • Disponível automóvel alugado;
  • Vale Combustível.


Junte-se à Lindt


Inscreva-se e faça parte do legado!

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
TITLE:

Senior Mobile Engineer


LOCATION/GEOGRAPHY:

Brasília, Brazil


REPortS TO:

R&D Manager


Role summary:

As a Senior Mobile Engineer at Vingcard, you will be instrumental in maintaining and developing new features for our native iOS and Android applications. With your extensive experience in mobile development, particularly in Swift and Kotlin, you will ensure the continuous enhancement of our mobile platforms. This role will involve leading the implementation of automated testing and CI/CD pipelines to improve app quality and reliability. You will also contribute to the integration of IoT devices and may explore hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native.


Key Responsibilities :

  • Develop and maintain native iOS and Android applications.
  • Implement new features and functionalities on the Athos mobile apps.
  • Design and execute automated tests to ensure the reliability and performance of mobile applications.
  • Establish and optimize CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps to streamline development and deployment processes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including UX/UI designers, product managers, and backend engineers, to deliver high-quality mobile solutions.
  • Lead initiatives to integrate IoT devices with mobile applications, enhancing product capabilities.
  • Explore and possibly implement hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native as needed.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in mobile apps, ensuring minimal downtime and high user satisfaction.


Key Relationships:

  • Work closely with Product Managers to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet business objectives.
  • Collaborate with Designers to create intuitive, user-friendly mobile interfaces.
  • Engage with other Engineers to solve technical challenges and share best practices.
  • Interface with Quality Assurance teams to ensure thorough testing and validation of mobile applications.


Responsibilities and Authorities:

List of responsibilities and authorities:

  • Authority to make technical decisions regarding the design and architecture of mobile applications.
  • Access to development tools, version control systems, and other resources necessary for mobile app development.
  • Responsibility for the timely and high-quality delivery of mobile features and improvements.
  • Authority to mentor junior developers and guide them in best practices for mobile development.
  • Reporting to the R&D Manager for project updates, technical decisions, and career development matters.


Internal and External Contacts/Customers:

  • Regular collaboration with internal teams, including Product Management, Design, and Software Engineering.
  • Occasional engagement with external stakeholders, such as technology partners.


Key Competencies, Relevant Knowledge, Skills and Competencies:

  • Expertise in native iOS and Android development, with deep knowledge of Swift (for iOS) and Kotlin (for Android).
  • Experience in integrating IoT devices with mobile applications.
  • Proficiency in automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for mobile development.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex mobile app issues.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Adaptability and a continuous improvement mindset, with an eagerness to learn new technologies like Flutter or React Native.


Requirements:

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in mobile app development, with a focus on native iOS and Android platforms.
  • Extensive experience with Kotlin and Swift, with a preference for Android development expertise.
  • Experience with IoT devices and hybrid mobile frameworks (Flutter/React Native) is a plus.


Education:

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field.


Languages:

Proficiency in English and Brazilian Portuguese, both written and verbal.


Computer Skills:

  • Proficiency in development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Expertise in Swift and Kotlin, with familiarity in hybrid frameworks like Flutter or React Native.


Other Experience:

  • Senior Mobile Engineer or equivalent position in a software development environment.
  • Experience in mentoring and guiding junior developers.
  • Minimum 7 years experience.


Personal Qualities:

  • Strong leadership and mentoring abilities.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead mobile projects.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on quality and best practices in mobile development.
  • Flexible and adaptable, with a passion for learning and implementing new technologies.


Expected outcome and deliverables:

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Mobile Engineer will significantly enhance the Athos mobile applications by implementing robust features, automated testing, and efficient CI/CD pipelines. The role will contribute to the integration of IoT devices, potentially explore hybrid mobile development, and drive the overall quality and performance of the apps. These efforts will solidify Athos's position as a leader in innovative mobile solutions, with noticeable improvements in app reliability, user satisfaction, and market competitiveness.


Vingcard Athos Team

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.


We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!


Contract Details

  • You will be a registered employee (CLT) of ASSA ABLOY GLOBAL SOLUTIONS IMPORTACAO EXPORTACAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRONICOS LTDA.
  • Benefits include Vale Refeição.
  • Benefits include health insurance (plano de saúde) for you, your spouse and your children at no additional cost.


We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 61,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Frontend Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will own the end-to-end development of high-impact features, mentor junior engineers, and drive best practices that ensure our sales analytics products scale with the business.


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and optimize complex React applications and reusable component libraries
  • Lead technical design reviews and establish frontend coding standards across the team
  • Collaborate with product, UX, and backend engineers to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks, accessibility issues, and cross-browser inconsistencies
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through pair programming, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions
  • Own release planning, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing strategies to maintain >90 % test coverage


Need to Haves

  • 5+ years of production experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Proven track record of delivering scalable, high-performance frontend solutions
  • Strong English skills – comfortable presenting technical decisions to stakeholders and writing detailed RFCs
  • Demonstrated leadership in driving technical excellence and mentoring teams


Nice to Haves

  • Deep domain expertise in sales or revenue analytics (CRM integrations, forecasting dashboards)
  • Experience building and governing enterprise-grade design systems or HEX component libraries
  • Proficiency with Next.js, GraphQL, and cloud-native deployment (AWS Amplify, Vercel, or similar)

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.


The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.


Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.


Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.


Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.


No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.


About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
Syndigo powers the continual flow of data and content throughout the entire commerce ecosystem— accelerating delivery of accurate and compelling information that increases sales on every shelf. We are the recognized leader in software and services for the management of master data, product information, digital assets, and content syndication and analytics across industries including grocery, foodservice, hardlines, home improvement, oil & gas, pet, health and beauty, automotive, apparel, and healthcare products.

Syndigo serves the industry’s largest two-sided network, connecting more than 50,000 global users across 12,000+ global brands with more than 1,750 global retailers.

Basically, we're the people that deliver the rich, accurate product content that helps consumers shop online with confidence, and helps brands and retailers operate efficient product supply chains. We cannot do all of this without our amazing employees who make the magic happen here at Syndigo. As we continue to grow, we’re always looking to identify talented individuals to join our team.

**Candidate must be located in Joinville, Santa Catarina**

We are looking for a talented, communicative, and highly driven Senior Account Executive  to join our team at  Syndigo . In this role,  you’ll serve as a trusted partner to our clients—managing relationships, driving consultative sales, resolving issues, and supporting questions throughout the customer lifecycle. We value professionals who are agile, proactive, and passionate about delivering exceptional solutions.

HOW WE’LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY

  • Manage the full consultative sales cycle, from prospecting to closing.  
  • Actively  identify  and engage potential customers to build a strong pipeline.  
  • Lead regular meetings with suppliers and clients to introduce  new solutions  and strengthen relationships.  
  • Conduct  timely  and  accurate  follow‑ups based on sales funnel stages.
  • Prepare, present, and deliver high‑quality commercial proposals.  
  • Negotiate pricing and commercial terms to successfully close opportunities.  
  • Maintain an organized schedule and ensure all lead/client information is accurately updated in the CRM.  
  • Lead retention discussions and negotiate solutions with suppliers at risk of  churn .  
  • Participate in onsite client visits as needed.  
  • Represent  Syndigo  at trade shows, fairs, and other industry events.  
  • Identify  opportunities to improve internal processes, product offerings, or customer experience.

WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU 

  • 4+ years of relevant experience  
  • Bachelor’s degree  
  • Advanced English and Brazilian Portuguese  proficiency  
  • Proven experience in commercial sales roles  
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills  
  • Strong technical  proficiency   (Microsoft 365)  
  • Effective problem-solving, planning, and  organization  abilities
Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating.

Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it’s how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful! 

All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth! 

GDPR/CCPA

Syndigo, to process applications, holds onto data for a "reasonable time" after applications are submitted. This data is stored for Syndigo's internal use by HR/Recruiting Staff only. Verified requests for data deletion and exports will be completed upon request.

At Syndigo, we care about your privacy. As you go through our recruitment process, we are committed to being transparent about how we process your personal data. To learn more about how Syndigo processes your personal data, go to our Job Applicant Privacy Notice .

title: Assistente de cadastro
description:
Syndigo powers the continual flow of data and content throughout the entire commerce ecosystem— accelerating delivery of accurate and compelling information that increases sales on every shelf. We are the recognized leader in software and services for the management of master data, product information, digital assets, and content syndication and analytics across industries including grocery, foodservice, hardlines, home improvement, oil & gas, pet, health and beauty, automotive, apparel, and healthcare products.

Syndigo serves the industry’s largest two-sided network, connecting more than 50,000 global users across 12,000+ global brands with more than 1,750 global retailers.

Basically, we're the people that deliver the rich, accurate product content that helps consumers shop online with confidence, and helps brands and retailers operate efficient product supply chains. We cannot do all of this without our amazing employees who make the magic happen here at Syndigo. As we continue to grow, we’re always looking to identify talented individuals to join our team.

***Candidate Must Be Located in Joinville, Santa Catarina***

As a Junior Registration Analyst at  Syndigo ,  you’ll  play a key role in ensuring product information is  accurate , complete, and ready for approval. This position is perfect for detail-oriented individuals who enjoy working with data and supporting quality processes.

HOW WE’LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY

  • Review and interpret product packaging information and enter it into our technology platform
  • Ensure all data follows predefined guidelines and models
  • Audit content created by team members and third-party contributors for accuracy
  • Validate and correct information before manufacturer approva

WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU 

  • Completed secondary education  required ; higher education (in progress or completed) is a plus
  • Technical Skills: Comfortable with Windows systems and Microsoft Office tools
  • Soft Skills: Strong attention to detail, ability to follow structured processes, and clear communication skills
  • Experience:  No prior experience  required — we’ll  provide training!
  • Ability to work in-person at our Joinville office, 5 days a week.
Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating.

Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it’s how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful! 

All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth! 

GDPR/CCPA

Syndigo, to process applications, holds onto data for a "reasonable time" after applications are submitted. This data is stored for Syndigo's internal use by HR/Recruiting Staff only. Verified requests for data deletion and exports will be completed upon request.

Syndigo Job Applicant Privacy Notice

At Syndigo, we care about your privacy. As you go through our recruitment process, we are committed to being transparent about how we process your personal data. To learn more about how Syndigo processes your personal data, go to our Job Applicant Privacy Notice .

title: Gerente de engenharia de software
description:
Título do Cargo: Gerente de Modernização e Arquiteto Líder de Soluções em IA (AI Problem-Solving Architect)


Buscamos uma Liderança Disruptiva e altamente técnica para atuar como Gerente de Modernização e Arquiteto Líder de Soluções em IA. Este profissional será o principal resolvedor de problemas técnicos de alto nível, responsável por conceber, projetar e liderar a implementação de arquiteturas de Inteligência Artificial de última geração, com foco em sistemas de multiagentes. O papel exige profundos conhecimentos em LLMs, RAG, Deep Learning e experiência prática com orquestração de agentes (ex: CrewAI, LangChain), visando a criação de soluções mais eficazes, determinísticas e com alucinação minimizada. O líder será responsável por guiar e desenvolver uma equipe de 8 profissionais de alto desempenho, garantindo a transformação e modernização contínua dos nossos sistemas e processos.


1. Liderança e Gestão de Pessoas (Liderança Disruptiva):

  • Liderar, inspirar e gerenciar uma equipe multidisciplinar de 8 profissionais (Cientistas de Dados, Engenheiros de IA/ML, etc.), promovendo uma cultura de experimentação, alta performance, agilidade e disrupção.
  • Definir prioridades estratégicas, acompanhar o progresso dos projetos e garantir a entrega de soluções de IA que geram valor de negócio mensurável.
  • Atuar como mentor técnico, estimulando o desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe nas mais recentes tecnologias de IA, Orquestração e LLMs.


2. Arquitetura e Engenharia de Soluções de IA:

  • Ser o "Arquiteto de Soluções de Problemas em AI", traduzindo desafios complexos de negócio em projetos de arquitetura de IA escaláveis, robustos e inovadores.
  • Projetar e otimizar sistemas de orquestração de Multiagentes , definindo fluxos de trabalho, comunicação (A2A - Agent-to-Agent) e protocolos de interação.
  • Desenhar e implementar arquiteturas baseadas em LLMs (Large Language Models) e sistemas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) .
  • Garantir a integração e modernização das soluções de IA com os sistemas legados e plataformas de nuvem (AWS, Azure, GCP).


3. Governança e Otimização de Agentes:

  • Desenvolver e aplicar metodologias e técnicas avançadas de Prompt Engineering e Context Engineering para controlar e guiar o comportamento dos agentes.
  • Implementar mecanismos de "guardrails" e estratégias de validação para diminuir a alucinação dos agentes , aumentando a eficácia, a precisão e o comportamento determinístico das soluções de IA.
  • Definir padrões de MLOps (Machine Learning Operations), governança e monitoramento para garantir a estabilidade, segurança e conformidade das soluções em produção.


4. Estratégia e Inovação em Modernização:

  • Identificar e propor oportunidades de modernização tecnológica e disrupção em processos-chave da organização através do uso estratégico da IA.
  • Conduzir a avaliação e a adoção de novas ferramentas e frameworks de IA (como CrewAI, LangChain, AutoGen, etc.) para acelerar a inovação e o desenvolvimento de produtos.


Experiência Técnica (Hard Skills):

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada no papel de Arquiteto de Soluções, Arquiteto de Sistemas Sênior e função de liderança técnica equivalente, com foco em IA/ML.
  • Conhecimento Profundo (Hands-on) em:
  • LLMs (Large Language Models) e suas arquiteturas (Transformer, etc.).
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) e otimização de bases de conhecimento para LLMs.
  • Orquestração de Multiagentes: Experiência prática com frameworks como CrewAI, LangChain ou ferramentas similares.
  • Deep Learning e frameworks como PyTorch ou TensorFlow.
  • Arquitetura de dados para IA (Vector Databases, Feature Stores, Data Pipelines).
  • MLOps e CI/CD para modelos e sistemas de IA.
  • Experiência comprovada em técnicas de mitigação de bias e alucinação em LLMs, visando a deterministicidade.

Liderança e Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills):

  • Liderança Disruptiva: Capacidade de desafiar o status quo , promover a mudança, tomar decisões ousadas e construir uma visão tecnológica ambiciosa.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação para interagir com a equipe, stakeholders técnicos e executivos.
  • Visão Estratégica e Habilidade de Solução de Problemas (AI Problem-Solving Architect).


Diferenciais


  • Experiência prévia em modernização de sistemas legados utilizando IA.
  • Publicações, contribuições ou participação ativa em comunidades de IA Generativa e Sistemas Multiagentes.
  • Certificações em Arquitetura de Nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) focadas em IA/ML.

title: Consultor de Vendas Pleno - Off Trade São Paulo

title: Assistente de Folha de Pagamento (DP)
description:
Descrição da Empresa

A ContabilizaEcom é uma empresa de contabilidade especialmente voltada para o e‑commerce, que combina expertise fiscal, tributária e empresarial para apoiar lojas online no Brasil.

Alguns destaques da empresa:

  • Foi criada por quem “nasceu em um e‑commerce”, ou seja, compreende os desafios práticos desse tipo de negócio.
  • Oferece serviços como abertura de empresa, análise fiscal de produtos, configuração de ERP e canais de venda, recuperação de impostos pagos indevidamente, planejamento tributário e busca de benefícios fiscais.
  • Foca em economia de impostos, segurança jurídica e regularização fiscal dos seus clientes.
  • Tem métricas que demonstram credibilidade: mais de 300 sellers ativos, cerca de 96% de satisfação dos clientes e mais de R$ 10 milhões em impostos economizados.


Sobre a Vaga:

Estamos procurando um Assistente de Folha de Pagamento (DP) para se juntar à equipe da ContabilizaEcom em Curitiba. Este cargo envolve a execução de tarefas diárias relacionadas a folha de pagamento no setor de departamento pessoal que busque a garantia de conformidade com as leis trabalhistas e legais vigentes.


Este é um cargo de tempo integral presencial, permitindo algumas atividades administrativas realizadas remotamente, onde o colaborador tem espaço para o crescimento em um ambiente descontraído com limites e responsabilidades.


Qualificações acadêmicas esperadas e atribuições da função


  • Formação: Graduação cursando ou completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, RH ou áreas correlatas.
  • Processamento da Folha: Executar o cálculo mensal da folha de pagamento, garantindo a exatidão de salários, descontos e proventos.
  • Cálculo de Encargos: Calcular e conferir o INSS, FGTS e IRRF.
  • Fechamento e Conferência: Realizar o fechamento da folha e emitir os relatórios de conferência (holerites), assegurando a conformidade legal.
  • Emissão de Guias: Gerar e enviar as guias de recolhimento dos encargos sociais e impostos (Ex: DAF, GPS/DARF Previdenciário).
  • Rotinas de Pessoal: executar cálculo e registro de férias e processamento de rescisões contratuais, com o devido registro no sistema.
  • Obrigações Acessórias: Realizar o lançamento e acompanhamento dos eventos mensais e periódicos no eSocial, garantindo a qualidade e o envio das informações.
  • Atendimento: Prestar suporte e esclarecimento de dúvidas aos colaboradores sobre holerites, benefícios e questões trabalhistas básicas.


Competências Comportamentais


  • Organização.

Remuneração:

  • Salário a combinar (enviar pretensão salarial no currículo)

Benefícios:

  • Vale alimentação
  • Vale transporte
  • Plano de saúde
  • Plano odontológico
  • Plano de carreira

title: Yr 5 Classroom Teacher
description:
About ANZUK Education

ANZUK Education has supported educators since 2004. We’re able to fully support schools and educators by finding the right educator, right place, right time. Our International Schools Team is dedicated to ensuring equity in education for students by connecting great teachers to schools that truly value them.


The School

The school offers British International education to pupils in EYFS, Primary and Secondary School up to Year 13. The school is located in an exclusive district of Brasilia and enjoys a spacious, green, clean-air environment.


Since opening in 2016, the school has established itself as the school of choice for many expatriate and Brazilian parents seeking an international education in Brasilia. The core of our curriculum is British, with a distinct international flavour. The staff have experience of working both in the UK and abroad and are drawn from a range of countries and cultures.



Responsibilities



  • Teaching and Learning
  • Plan, prepare, and deliver creative and engaging lessons in line with the curriculum and school policies.
  • Ensure that all pupils make good progress by using effective assessment to inform planning and adapt teaching to meet individual needs.
  • Use innovative and effective teaching strategies and resources, including technology to support pupil progress.
  • Work collaboratively with colleagues to plan for and support pupils learning.
  • Assessment and Pupil Progress
  • Pastoral and Personal Development
  • Promote the welfare, personal development, and well-being of pupils in all aspects of school life.
  • Act as a mentor, supporting pupils’ academic and personal growth.
  • Curriculum Contribution and Wider Engagement
  • Contribute to the ongoing review and development of the curriculum, schemes of work, and learning resources.
  • Engage in professional dialogue with colleagues to share best practices and refine teaching strategies.
  • Participate in school trips, events, and extracurricular activities that enrich pupils’ learning experiences.



Qualifications



Applicant must have a recognised Teaching qualification eg Bachelor of Teaching/Education, Masters of Education - or similar



Required Skills



Applicant must be a fully qualified teacher, ideally with a minimum of 1 year experience in the classroom and be able to start immediately!




Pay range and compensation package



  • High quality Accommodation provided by school
  • Travel and Relocation Allowance
  • Retention bonuses on offer
  • Annual salary from R$220,000 p/a


To find out more - please contact or check out some of our other International School opportunities HERE

title: Engenheiro de Dados Pleno
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados para integrar nosso time responsável pela evolução de uma plataforma Data Lakehouse na AWS . Essa pessoa terá papel fundamental na integração de dados de múltiplas fontes, na orquestração de pipelines confiáveis e na disponibilização de camadas analíticas performáticas para consumo via Amazon Redshift e Power BI .


Modelo de atuação: Híbrido (2 a 3 vezes por semana)

Localidade: Brasília


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e implementar pipelines de dados utilizando Airflow/MWAA , com Python e SQL , seguindo boas práticas de modularidade, testes e versionamento.
  • Modelar camadas Bronze/Silver/Gold (arquitetura Medallion) em S3 + Glue Data Catalog , definindo partições, formatos (Parquet/Delta*) e tabelas otimizadas para consulta.
  • Construir e otimizar modelos analíticos em Amazon Redshift , garantindo performance e custo.
  • Publicar e manter datasets confiáveis para Power BI , incluindo gateways, incremental refresh, agregações e uso eficiente de DirectQuery/Import.
  • Colaborar com analistas e times de negócio, traduzindo necessidades em datasets, KPIs e camadas consumíveis, além de documentar catálogos e contratos de dados.


Requisitos e qualificações


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida em AWS : S3, Glue Data Catalog, Airflow (preferencialmente MWAA), DAGs em Python, Amazon Redshift.
  • Linguagens: Python e SQL avançado .
  • Power BI : modelagem semântica, DAX, incremental refresh, gateway, boas práticas para consumo de Redshift.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura Data Lakehouse , formatos colunares (Parquet), partições e metadados.
  • Boas práticas de engenharia: Git, testes, code reviews, documentação, pipelines confiáveis.
  • Segurança e governança: IAM, criptografia, princípios de mínimo privilégio, LGPD aplicada a dados.

title: Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Finance Manager will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations.
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.g. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in finance and tax management, including 3+ years in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, manage pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

title: Sales Development Representative (SaaS | Contractor)
description:
About SleekFlow

Join SleekFlow, a thriving SaaS startup that is experiencing rapid growth thanks to the support of renowned investors which include Atinum Investment, Tiger Global, Transcend Capital and Gobi Partners. At SleekFlow, we have developed an Omnichannel Conversational AI Suite that drives conversions through conversations. Our platform seamlessly integrates with popular channels such as WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, WeChat, and more, providing comprehensive communication solutions. With our customer engagement platform, both small merchants and large enterprises can automate growth by enhancing productivity across their sales, marketing, and support teams.


As we expand into emerging markets, we seek adventurous, diverse, and passionate individuals to join us on this exciting journey. Join our team and grow your career with SleekFlow!

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Prior Experience in Saas/ Software Industry is preferred

Language: Fluent in English & Portuguese; Professional proficiency in Spanish


Role

We are looking for an ambitious Growth Partnership Executive to join our dynamic sales team. In this role, you will build and manage prospect relationships to drive revenue for SleekFlow. A vital part of this opportunity is partnering with the Customer Success and Product team to ensure the quality and quantity of sales pipeline.


Responsibilities

  • Handle our sales conversion process for Small & Medium Businesses
  • Developing and managing relationships within our Commercial segment with customers in the LATAM region.
  • Forecast sales activity and revenue achievement while creating satisfied and reference-able customers
  • Research and build >40 "cold accounts" (i.e.: adding contacts, sending emails, cold calling) everyday
  • Support our inbound and outbound sales teams in closing enterprise clients
  • Qualify leads and nurture them through the initial stages of the buyer journeys
  • Handle inbound tickets
  • Document all interactions and findings with leads in our CRM, and create a seamless handoff process to Account Executives
  • Involve in our International Market Expansion
  • Work with our sales teams, customer support, partnership and training team in Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, UAE and oversee the market launch project
  • Ability to stay up to date in the SaaS landscape and demonstrate our platform value


Requirements

  • Minimum 1 years of outbound sales or sales development experience (selling over the phone, cold calling), preferably B2B at a software company
  • Profound academic background from top-notch universities
  • Extensive experience selling to customers in the LATAM region
  • Consistently over-achieved quota (top 5-10% of the company) in past positions
  • Fluency in English is a MUST
  • Previous Experience in a startup is preferred


Desired Skills

  • Strong and demonstrated written and verbal communication skills.
  • Previous Sales Methodology training preferred.
  • CRM (e.g. Hubspot) & marketing experience preferred
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, team environment.
  • Strong customer references
  • Strong computer skills, including CRM, Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel.



Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate.


SleekFlow is a place where everyone can grow. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

Inglês fluente é requisito obrigatório, considerando interação recorrente com stakeholders internacionais.


Modelo de atuação híbrido: três vezes por semana (segunda, terça e quinta-feira)


Objetivo da vaga:

Atuar como Product Owner responsável pela condução, priorização e evolução das iniciativas de modelagem de risco de crédito, garantindo que as necessidades de negócio sejam corretamente traduzidas em backlog e entregas técnicas, considerando dois pilares estruturantes do modelo:


1 - Pilar Crédito – variáveis, premissas, regras e lógica do modelo de risco de crédito;

2 - Pilar Agro – variáveis do agronegócio que influenciam diretamente o risco de crédito e precisam ser incorporadas ao modelo.


O profissional será responsável por garantir continuidade, qualidade e governança do conhecimento, evitando perda de contexto ao final de projetos e assegurando evolução contínua do modelo.


Escopo técnico da atuação


Pilar 1 – Modelagem e variáveis de crédito

Entendimento profundo da lógica de modelos de risco de crédito (inputs, premissas, critérios de decisão, indicadores e outputs);

Atuação próxima às áreas de risco e dados para definição, priorização e evolução das variáveis do modelo;

Tradução de necessidades regulatórias, de negócio e operacionais em requisitos claros para times técnicos;

Garantia de rastreabilidade entre necessidade de negócio → backlog → entrega técnica → resultado.


Pilar 2 – Variáveis do agro aplicadas ao risco de crédito

Compreensão das variáveis do agronegócio que impactam o risco de crédito (ex.: sazonalidade, produtividade, clima, ciclos agrícolas, indicadores setoriais);

Capacidade de estruturar essas variáveis como hipóteses, requisitos e critérios de priorização dentro do modelo;

Interface com áreas de domínio (quando necessário) para garantir correta interpretação e aplicação das variáveis no contexto de crédito.


Responsabilidades

Definir, priorizar e manter o backlog das iniciativas de modelagem de risco de crédito;

Conduzir refinamentos e planejamentos com foco técnico e objetivo, garantindo clareza para os times de dados/modelagem;

Escrever user stories, critérios de aceite e dependências com nível de detalhamento adequado para execução técnica;

Garantir alinhamento contínuo entre negócio, risco, dados e tecnologia;

Atuar como ponto central de governança do tema, preservando conhecimento e histórico das decisões do modelo;

Acompanhar entregas, validações e indicadores de qualidade do modelo;

Apoiar decisões estratégicas relacionadas à evolução do risco de crédito.


Requisitos obrigatórios

Experiência sólida como Product Owner (ou papel equivalente) em contextos analíticos, dados ou modelagem;

Vivência prática com modelagem de risco de crédito (variáveis, lógica de decisão, indicadores);

Capacidade comprovada de atuar entre negócio e times técnicos (data science/modelagem/engenharia de dados);

Experiência com metodologias ágeis e gestão de backlog em ambientes complexos;

Autonomia, organização e clareza na comunicação técnica.


Diferenciais relevantes

Experiência com agronegócio aplicado a crédito;

Vivência em ambientes regulados e com forte exigência de governança;

Histórico de atuação garantindo continuidade de conhecimento entre projetos.

Habilidades Comportamentais:

- Metodologias Ágeis

title: Data Scientist
description:
Mission Description:

Join our Advanced Analytics team as a Data Scientist in the Commercial Performance Tower. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying scalable machine learning models that drive business impact. This is a hands-on role focused on model development, deployment, and optimization in real-world commercial environments.


About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled and proactive Data Scientist to strengthen our analytics capabilities. You will work on high-impact projects involving recommendation systems, demand forecasting, and predictive modeling using state-of-the-art techniques. The ideal candidate is passionate about turning data into actionable insights and has strong experience in model deployment within cloud environments (Azure, Databricks). You will collaborate closely with data engineers, ML engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver end-to-end data science solutions that optimize commercial performance.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and optimize recommendation systems (collaborative filtering, content-based, hybrid approaches)
  • Build and validate time series forecasting models using ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, and other ML-based methods
  • Implement and tune boosting algorithms (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) and decision tree-based models for classification and regression tasks
  • Perform end-to-end data exploration, feature engineering, and model evaluation
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy models into production on Azure and Databricks
  • Translate business problems into analytical frameworks and communicate results to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Stay current with emerging trends and tools in machine learning and data science



Profile Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics , or a related quantitative field


Experience & Skills:

  • Proven experience in recommender systems and time series forecasting
  • Strong expertise in boosting algorithms (XGBoost, etc.) and decision trees
  • Proficiency in Python and key libraries: scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, statsmodels
  • Experience with Azure Machine Learning , Databricks , and cloud-based model deployment
  • Familiarity with C++ (a plus for performance-critical components)
  • Solid understanding of ML lifecycle , from prototyping to production
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) – essential for global collaboration


Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a high-performing analytics team driving real business impact
  • Work on cutting-edge machine learning applications in a dynamic commercial environment
  • Access to modern tools and cloud infrastructure (Azure, Databricks)
  • Opportunities for growth within the Mantu Group ecosystem

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

The Senior Cost Controller is responsible for ensuring accurate financial control, cost management, and compliance across business units, supporting operational performance and strategic decision-making, particularly within FPSO operations.

Ensure timely and reliable financial closing and statutory reporting;

Maintain, review, and improve accounting procedures, processes, and internal controls;

Ensure group reporting meets corporate, audit, and tax compliance requirements;

Liaise with operations and provide finance/accounting support to business units;

Resolve accounting and financial queries and support cross-functional activities as needed.


Requirements

Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in FPSO or offshore oil & gas operations;

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related fields;

Fluent English;

Strong knowledge of financial controls, cost management, and Brazilian tax legislation;

Experience with IFS ERP is a strong advantage.


Benefits

Meal and food allowances

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)

Life Insurance

Annual Bonus

Private Pension Plan

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

description:

about Randstad Enterprise

Randstad Sourceright is a global talent leader, providing solutions and expertise that help companies position for growth, execute on strategy, and improve business agility. Our experience encompasses all facets of the talent acquisition of permanent employees and the contingent and contractor workforce. Key offerings include Managed Services Provider (MSP) programs, Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), and Blended Workforce Solutions. Randstad Sourceright offers solutions Globally in North America, EMEA, and APAC. Working for a multi-country organization means working with clients and colleagues from different backgrounds. This results in a digital way of working and requires a proactive and culturally inclusive mindset.


job context

and purpose


Purpose of the job

This role aims to partner with the Regional and global BI customers within RSR (who can include but are not limited to Data engineering, BI Support Teams, Operational Teams, Internal teams, and RSR clients) and provide business solutions through data.

This position has operational and technical responsibility for reporting, analytics, and visualization dashboards across all operating companies within RSR. This position will develop processes and strategies to consolidate, automate, and improve reporting and dashboards for external clients and internal stakeholders.

As a Business Intelligence Partner, you will oversee the end-to-end delivery of regional and global account and client BI reporting. This will include working with data engineering to provide usable datasets, creating dashboards with meaningful insights & visualizations within our BI solution, and ongoing communication and partnering with the ‘BI consumers. Must be knowledgeable in Tableau and SQL. The key to this is that as a Business Intelligence Partner, you will be a commercial and operational expert who can translate data into insights. You will use this to mitigate risk, find operational and revenue-generating opportunities, and provide business solutions.


Key stakeholders

  • RSR internal stakeholders include but are not limited to C-Suite, Finance, Regional Managing Directors, Vice Presidents, and operational account leaders.
  • RSR external clients


Position Summary

Development of BI solutions (50%):

  • Responsible for delivering BI solutions for the program
  • Responsible for ensuring all contractual conditions around reporting, financial elements, SLA's, and KPI's are reviewed, understood, and adhered to
  • Assess operating reality to validate solution requirements and adjust as needed.
  • Implement and reinforce tools, including standards, procedures, and documentation.
  • Ensure the team has living documentation on reporting requirements, data processes, and other program-specific content.
  • Oversee the design and build of insightful, scalable, and actionable visualizations.
  • Develop, document, and maintain a comprehensive quality management program
  • Build, implement, and schedule production standards of files and reports to ensure accuracy and timeliness.
  • Ensure reporting quality and accuracy by evaluating, integrating, and complementing data sources.
  • Execute continuous process improvement process.
  • Knowledge of general database functions, data storage, data models, SQL, and data transfer protocols

Consult (30%):

  • Responsible for being the liaison between the external client, operations teams and the wider BI teams
  • Using client data and insights to highlight and provide observations, provide recommendations, and contribute to ongoing business discussions and decision-making.
  • Analyze the client’s data to present the account leadership and client with potential approaches or opportunities for improving service delivery performance and elevating value-added opportunities.
  • Have commercial awareness and work with the account leadership to maximize revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Solicit feedback from internal and external stakeholders in an organized manner to contribute to the objectives of the BI team and demonstrate RSR value.
  • Contribute to the success of a wider global team.
  • Qualify the business needs of each request and use expertise to partner on solutions.
  • Develop strong working relationships with the client stakeholders and account leads.
  • Serve as a functional and technical data visualization and business intelligence subject matter expert.

Maintain Standards (20%):

  • Work within the agreed parameters aligned to the global method of BI production
  • Leverage an agile work environment to incorporate new innovative and value components into existing portfolios
  • Organize a feedback standard from stakeholders (internal and external) in order to create use case, case study materials and other customer-facing material
  • Promote available resources and enterprise tools for operations training/ coaching needs from a BI perspective.
  • Ensure data governance principles and guidelines are being met


job

title: the Local Sales Manager
description:
Job Profile for the Local Sales Manager in Brazil

One、Job Description

  1. Core Positioning: Develop the Brazilian market by cooperating with Choho's self-owned brand and Honda Brazil.
  2. Reporting Relationship: After-sales service of motorcycle chain systems in the Brazilian market.
  3. Core Objectives: Achieve sales of 10 million RMB for the self-owned brand in the Brazilian market, build the image of the Choho brand in the Brazilian market, and promote cooperation with Honda Brazil for parts supply.

Two、Core responsibilities

1、Strategic planning and execution: Based on the company's overall development strategy, conduct market research in the Brazilian market, conduct in-depth analysis of each state in Brazil, select and study promising suppliers and agents.

2、Customer development and maintenance: Develop Brazilian Choho brand agents and follow up on the cooperation intentions with Honda in Brazil.。

3、Marketing: Develop overseas marketing strategies, establish overseas channel networks, orderly carry out marketing promotion activities, and build the company's brand image.

4、 Organizational design and team building: Design an organizational structure, business processes and incentive mechanisms that can support the realization of overseas strategies, and build high-performance business teams.

Three、Job Requirements

(one)Educational Background

1. Education and qualifications: Bachelor's degree from a Brazilian university. Prior experience in retail or fast-moving consumer goods industry is preferred.

2.Major: International trade, foreign languages, mechanical engineering, etc. Candidates with sales experience or background related to motorcycle industry are preferred.

(Two)Work Experience

1、At least 3 years of experience in the sales industry.

2、Candidates with experience in product sales in industries such as chain drive, automotive parts, home appliances, and motorcycles will be given priority consideration.

(Three)Knowledge and Skills

1、It is required to be proficient in both Portuguese and English or Portuguese and Chinese, with fluent skills in listening, speaking, reading and writing.

2、Possess excellent personal qualities, business negotiation skills, stress-resistance ability, result-oriented mindset, and the ability to adapt to frequent business trips.

3、Possess the abilities of team management, organizational coordination, work guidance, analysis and judgment, as well as problem-solving.。

Work Location: Brazil

Salary: Negotiable at interview.

  • Registrar evolução de escopo, desvios e justificativas;
  • Conduzir sessões de lições aprendidas e implementar melhorias contínuas;
  • Manter alinhamento constante com a área Comercial quanto a impactos operacionais e execução conforme escopo contratado.

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos EPC e IMR;
  • Vivência em projetos industriais, navais ou de óleo e gás;
  • Sólida experiência em planejamento, controle de custos, análise de produtividade e gestão de grandes equipes;
  • Inglês fluente;
  • Conhecimento em metodologia EPC e gestão de projetos industriais;

  • Conhecimento em ERP (TOTVS/Fluig), plataformas de gestão de projetos e dashboards de BI;
  • Conhecimento das Normas NR-10, NR-13, NR-33, NR-35;
  • Conhecimento dos requisitos IACS, ABS e DNV.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência em projetos para a Petrobras;
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Microsoft Office (Word, Excel e PowerPoint);
  • Conhecimentos avançados em gestão e melhoria de processos.

title: Gerente Funcional de Turno - Fábrica
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Sobre a Função


Desafios:

Coordenar as demandas da fábrica alinhadas às estratégias de atingimento de resultados e munido de informações para as melhores tomadas de decisões referente ao balanço da fábrica, durante os turnos de trabalho e através do monitoramento dos indicadores de produção, em tempo real, avaliando e intervindo nos processos, aspectos e parâmetros, baseado nos procedimentos de tomada de decisão, visando a qualidade, a produtividade e a otimização dos custos de produção, garantindo a segurança dos colaboradores.

Principais Atividades:

  • Garantir a capacitação, treinamento técnico e legal (NRs) da equipe operacional, especialmente durante o startup e operação da planta.
  • Desdobrar e comunicar o plano estratégico corporativo à equipe de turno, assegurando o cumprimento das metas da fábrica.
  • Gerenciar a operação integrada do processo produtivo, da entrada da madeira à expedição da celulose, garantindo segurança, qualidade, produtividade e custos.
  • Coordenar e liderar equipes de operação e manutenção durante o turno, assegurando adequada alocação de recursos, gestão de conflitos e engajamento do time.
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas técnicos e operacionais, atuando em ajustes de processo, manutenções e paradas emergenciais.
  • Participar do planejamento estratégico da produção e da Parada Geral, identificando gargalos, riscos e oportunidades de otimização operacional e de custos.
  • Monitorar e gerir os indicadores de desempenho (SSMA, Qualidade, Produção e Custos), promovendo ações corretivas para o atingimento das metas e do EBITDA do negócio.
  • Elaborar e reportar informações de desempenho do turno, assegurando a continuidade operacional e a efetiva comunicação entre turnos.
  • Apoiar projetos de melhoria contínua, inovação e modernização de processos, equipamentos e ferramentas de gestão.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das políticas de Segurança, Meio Ambiente, Qualidade, Saúde Ocupacional, Ética e Compliance, bem como da legislação vigente.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharias e/ou afins;
  • Especialização em Celulose e Papel, Gestão de Projetos ou Equivalente;
  • Sólida vivência em fábrica de celulose;
  • Experiência em comissionamento e startup de plantas de Celulose e/ou Papel;
  • Inglês e Espanhol será um diferencial;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em Inocência/MS.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

Estamos plenamente convencidos de que uma equipe diversificada traz diferentes perspectivas, maior propriedade para resolver desafios e maior capacidade de inovação!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Us


We’re a rapidly growing energy focused startup specialising in ingesting, transforming, and delivering data from a wide range of third-party systems. Our platform integrates data via APIs, FTP, and other sources, processes it through our ETL pipelines before being made available to our customers. 


As we scale, we’re investing heavily in our data platform, with the aim of improving reliability, onboarding speed, and visibility. We’re looking for an Integration Developer to help us take this to the next level.


The Role


You’ll be responsible for building, maintaining, and improving our data integrations and pipelines. You’ll work closely with existing engineers to extend our ETL framework, onboard new data sources, and develop internal tools that make our data easier to understand, trust, and scale.


This role suits someone who enjoys solving messy, real-world problems, is comfortable working at pace, and wants to grow into a senior engineer as the company grows.


What You’ll Be Doing


Build and maintain data pipelines ingesting data from third-party systems.

Develop and extend Airflow DAGs to extract, transform, and load data.

Improve data traceability and observability.

Design and build internal tools, frameworks, or utilities to improve data onboarding and visibility.

Debug incomplete or poorly documented data problems independently.

Propose and evaluate new tools, technologies, and approaches where they make sense.

Balance delivery speed with long-term maintainability.

Collaborate closely with the wider team to continuously improve how we work.


What We’re Looking For


Core skills

  • Strong Python experience
  • Solid SQL skills, ideally with Postgres
  • Comfortable working with data pipelines and ETL concepts
  • Ability to reason through problems independently and communicate your thinking


Nice to have

  • Experience with Apache Airflow
  • Familiarity with AWS (especially S3, IAM, basic infrastructure concepts)
  • Previous experience working with third-party integrations or external data sources
  • Knowledge of the renewable energy sector specifically solar


How You Work

  • Curious and enthusiastic about learning new technologies and approaches
  • Comfortable speaking up, asking questions, and proposing solutions
  • Pragmatic — understands trade-offs between speed and technical debt
  • Self-aware, open to feedback, and able to acknowledge limitations
  • Collaborative, easy to work with
  • Enjoys pushing the envelope and improving how things are done


Seniority


We are looking for someone with senior-level potential. You should be confident in your fundamentals, eager to take ownership, and excited to grow alongside the company.


Why Join Us


  • Real ownership over critical systems
  • Direct impact on how the platform evolves
  • Space to experiment, learn, and influence technical direction
  • A collaborative team that values pragmatism, curiosity, and continuous improvement

description:
VAGA | ANALISTA DE CONTEÚDO ESTRATÉGICO

Rocket Aceleradora

﻿

LEIA COM ATENÇÃO ANTES DE SE CANDIDATAR

Essa não é uma vaga comum .


A Rocket Aceleradora está em fase de construção e escala e busca uma pessoa para assumir um papel central na operação , atuando diretamente ao lado do fundador.


Aqui, conteúdo não é estética .

Conteúdo é posicionamento, branding e vendas .

Conteúdo é estratégia aplicada em comunicação .


Se você procura uma vaga para:

  • apenas escrever posts
  • receber pauta pronta sem entender o contexto
  • trabalhar isolado do negócio
  • produzir conteúdo sem responsabilidade por impacto

essa vaga não é para você .


QUEM SOMOS

A Rocket é uma aceleradora focada em Marketing, Vendas e Tecnologia .

Atuamos em projetos em todo o Brasil, conectando estratégia, execução e performance.

Somos Platinum Partner RD Station (TOTVS) há quase 7 anos, participamos ativamente do ecossistema da RD e estamos concorrendo ao prêmio de Agência do Ano no programa.


Além da agência, temos um braço de tecnologia com soluções próprias, incluindo o Botzapp , software de automação e comunicação com foco em vendas e atendimento.

Estamos em um momento de transição de escala , crescimento de time e busca por voos maiores.

Essa vaga nasce exatamente nesse contexto.


O PAPEL (SEM ROMANTIZAÇÃO)

Você será Analista de Conteúdo Estratégico da Rocket.


Na prática, isso significa:

  • transformar estratégia em comunicação clara, persuasiva e distribuída
  • participar da construção de funis do ponto de vista da comunicação
  • escrever conteúdos que movem pessoas, não apenas preenchem calendário
  • atuar em múltiplos canais entendendo jornada, funil e objetivo


Você não será o estrategista geral do negócio ,

mas será o estrategista da comunicação dentro das estratégias definidas .

Aqui, conteúdo é parte central da máquina de crescimento.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER NA PRÁTICA

  • Planejar, produzir e evoluir conteúdos alinhados a funis de marketing e vendas
  • Escrever copy para diferentes etapas da jornada (topo, meio e fundo)
  • Produzir conteúdos para:
  • Blog (SEO)

  • E-mail marketing
  • Fluxos de automação e nutrição
  • Landing pages
  • Roteiros de vídeo
  • WhatsApp (quando aplicável)
  • Construir e manter calendários editoriais
  • Adaptar mensagens para diferentes canais, públicos e objetivos
  • Participar de reuniões estratégicas para entendimento profundo dos projetos
  • Atuar tanto em marcas próprias (Rocket e Botzapp) quanto em projetos de clientes
  • Analisar métricas e performance de conteúdos
  • Ajudar a estruturar padrões, processos e documentação de conteúdo


Aqui você escreve para resultado , não por escrever.


COMO VOCÊ SERÁ AVALIADO AQUI

Nos primeiros meses, seu crescimento será avaliado por:

  • clareza de raciocínio na comunicação
  • capacidade de transformar estratégia em mensagem
  • qualidade e consistência das entregas
  • evolução técnica em copy, SEO e automação
  • organização, responsabilidade e postura de dono sobre os projetos

Feedback é direto. Evolução é constante.


AMBIENTE DE CRESCIMENTO (ONDE VOCÊ VAI SE METER)

Trabalhamos conectados a plataformas e parceiros como:

  • RD Station
  • Meta
  • Google
  • ManyChat
  • Nuvemshop
  • Ferramentas de CRM, automação e performance


Na prática, isso significa:

  • aprendizado acelerado com ferramentas líderes de mercado
  • contato com benchmarks reais e estratégias avançadas
  • participação direta na construção de máquinas reais de aquisição e vendas


Aqui você joga o jogo grande desde cedo .


FERRAMENTAS QUE USAMOS

  • Monday.com (gestão de projetos)
  • Google Workspace (documentação e comunicação)
  • Botzapp (comunicação com clientes)
  • Google Agenda
  • WhatsApp (uso interno pontual)


HABILIDADES TÉCNICAS ESSENCIAIS

Você precisa ter boa base ou experiência em:

  • Copywriting aplicado a negócios
  • SEO (intenção de busca, estrutura, escaneabilidade e CTA)

  • Escrita estratégica para diferentes canais

  • Organização em ambientes com múltiplos projetos


Não buscamos alguém que saiba tudo.

Buscamos alguém que pense, execute e evolua rápido .


PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS (IMPORTANTE)

Buscamos alguém que:

  • já tenha experiência real com conteúdo digital
  • saiba escrever bem e pensar antes de escrever
  • entenda que conteúdo é parte do funil de vendas

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO

LOCALIZAÇÃO

CRESCIMENTO DE VERDADE

title: Audio Producer II
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.


Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.


In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.


About the position:

We are seeking an experienced and driven Audio Producer II with a background in audio production workflows. This role involves cross-functional collaboration, and managing external partnerships to deliver exceptional audio experiences. This role will provide hands-on support in voice-over production tasks, music editing, and operational processes , ensuring smooth workflows between the audio team, internal, and external partners.


Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate in voice-over production tasks, including communicating with vendors and internal local teams.
  • Communicate with internal and external partners to identify audio needs, plan execution, and ensure alignment from pre-production to delivery, acting as a key point of contact for audio-related matters.
  • Participate in the development of music, sound effects, and voice-over production schedules, ensuring alignment with multidisciplinary planning and vendor timelines.
  • Create comprehensive briefings for audio outsourcing partners, providing all necessary creative, technical, and production information.
  • Create, edit, and implement sound effects, voice-over assets, and other audio deliverables.
  • Mix audio content for publishing videos.
  • Ensure all audio deliverables meet project requirements, maintaining the highest quality standards across multiple projects.


Main job requirements:

  • Superior degree completed;
  • Proven experience (5+ years) in audio post-production workflow.
  • Expertise in audio editing tools such as Nuendo, Pro Tools, or similar.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills in English and Portuguese (written and spoken), with experience collaborating with internal teams and external partners.
  • Strong organizational and planning skills, with experience designing schedules and estimating budgets for complex projects.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving challenges.
  • Familiarity with generative AI audio tools (e.g., ElevenLabs, Suno).
  • Knowledge of middleware tools like Wwise or FMOD is a plus.
  • Passion for games or a strong understanding of gaming culture and player motivations;
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid mode).



- Please, make sure to share in your CV or Linkedin, the link of your portfolio/IMDB/Demo reel.

- Exclusivity contract required.

title: Produtor(a) Associado(a) de Podcast & Parcerias – SiiLA Next
description:

Estamos lançando uma nova versão do nosso podcast principal no Brasil e buscamos um(a) produtor(a) para apoiar a programação do podcast, a coordenação de produção e a prospecção de parcerias.

O podcast trará conversas com líderes e vozes relevantes de diferentes áreas profissionais. Agendamento e Coordenação de Convidados

Suporte à Produção e Editorial

• Coordenar cronogramas de produção e entregáveis com colaboradores internos e externos

• Revisar cortes de episódios, trailers e conteúdos de formato curto, oferecendo feedback prático e consistente

• Escalar preocupações criativas ou de qualidade quando necessário

Colaboração em Marketing e Lançamento

• Atuar em parceria com o time de marketing no posicionamento e promoção do podcast

• Apoiar a criação de sizzle reels, trailers e ativos de conteúdo curto

• Garantir consistência entre áudio, vídeo e canais sociais

Suporte a Afiliados e Patrocínios

• Apoiar o contato com parceiros afiliados, marcas e agências

• Auxiliar na preparação de materiais comerciais, media kits e acompanhamentos de propostas

• Ajudar a avaliar o alinhamento e a adequação das parcerias aos padrões da marca

Execução e Gestão de Stakeholders

• Manter fluxos de trabalho organizados entre múltiplos colaboradores e cronogramas

• Antecipar problemas e garantir o andamento contínuo das iniciativas

• Comunicar-se de forma clara e profissional com equipes internas e parceiros externos


Perfil Ideal

• Experiência na coordenação de stakeholders externos e na gestão de agendas e entregáveis

• Experiência em produção de conteúdo, podcasting, operações de mídia, parcerias, marketing de afiliados, patrocínios ou vendas de mídia é um diferencial

• Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma, mantendo alinhamento próximo com as prioridades da liderança


O Que Buscamos

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, com capacidade de interagir com executivos seniores e parceiros externos

• Perfil altamente organizado, proativo e capaz de gerenciar múltiplas frentes de trabalho simultaneamente

• Forte senso editorial, bom julgamento e alto padrão de qualidade

• Consciência comercial e interesse em patrocínios e monetização via afiliados

• Postura profissional, firme e decisiva, com conforto para dizer “não” quando necessário em prol da qualidade


Fluência em inglês é desejável.

title: Agente de Monitoramento

description:
